errors.auth: The NRGkick refused the username or password. Check them in the device settings.
errors.api_disabled: The local JSON API is off. Turn it on in the NRGkick app under Extended, Local API.
errors.timeout: The NRGkick did not answer in time. Check that it is powered and on the network.
errors.connection: Cannot reach the NRGkick. Check the IP address and that it is on the network.
errors.invalid_response: The NRGkick sent an unexpected answer. Check that it runs SmartModule firmware 4.0.0.0 or newer.
errors.no_serial: The NRGkick did not report a serial number.
errors.already_added: This NRGkick has already been added.
errors.no_host: Enter the IP address of the NRGkick.
errors.other_device: This address belongs to another NRGkick. Add that one as a separate device.
errors.offline: The NRGkick is not connected to the Connect module. Check that it is powered and close enough to the module.
errors.no_connect_host: Enter the IP address of the NRGkick Connect module.
errors.no_connect_devices: The Connect module answered, but it knows no NRGkick that is not added yet.
errors.connect_pin_needed: Enter the NRGkick PIN in the device settings: the Connect module needs it to change settings.
errors.no_ble_devices: No NRGkick found over Bluetooth. Check that it is powered and close to Homey, and close the NRGkick app on your phone: while it is connected, the NRGkick cannot be found.
errors.ble_read_only: Controlling a first-generation NRGkick over Bluetooth is not available yet. This driver only reads for now.
errors.ble_unreachable: Homey cannot reach the NRGkick over Bluetooth. Check that it is powered and close enough, and that the NRGkick app on your phone is closed.
errors.connect_timeout: The NRGkick Connect module did not answer in time. Check that it is powered and on the network.
errors.connect_connection: Cannot reach the NRGkick Connect module. Check its IP address and that it is on the network.
errors.connect_invalid_response: The NRGkick Connect module sent an unexpected answer. Check that the address belongs to the Connect module.
errors.connect_pin_wrong: The Connect module reports that the NRGkick PIN is wrong. Reading works, but changes will be refused: check the PIN in the device settings.

pair.select_intro: Tap your NRGkick to add it.
pair.manual_intro: Enter the address of your NRGkick. Make sure the JSON API is on in the NRGkick app (Extended, Local API).
pair.host_hint: You find it in the NRGkick app, or in your router's list of devices.
pair.api_disabled_intro: This NRGkick was found, but its local JSON API is off. Turn it on, then try again:
pair.api_step_1: Open the NRGkick app and connect to your NRGkick.
pair.connect_intro: Add a first-generation NRGkick through its NRGkick Connect module. This support is experimental.
pair.connect_searching: Looking for Connect modules on your network…
pair.connect_host: IP address of the Connect module
pair.connect_pin_hint: The Bluetooth PIN from the NRGkick app. Needed to control charging; reading works without it.
pair.ble_intro: Add a first-generation NRGkick over Bluetooth. Before you start:
pair.ble_point_untested: This support is limited and untested: it only reads values and cannot control charging yet.
pair.ble_point_range: Bluetooth has a short range. Homey must be close to the NRGkick, typically within about 10 metres and ideally without walls in between.
pair.ble_point_phone: Close the NRGkick app on your phone: while it is connected, Homey cannot find or read the NRGkick.
